scope: credential transport for the rented-GPU Llama route only

mechanism.token_source: SEM2ACT_HF_TOKEN process environment, injected as a platform secret at container start by the account owner
mechanism.delivery: explicit SEM2ACT_RENTED_RUN=1 branch in the kernel records the actual channel as rented_runtime_secret (no Kaggle-secrets masquerade); inert unless opted in, so Kaggle behavior is unchanged
mechanism.pre_inference_verification: huggingface_hub snapshot_download at the exact pinned revision, then byte-identity assertion of small files + streamed 4-shard hashes against cpu_source_probes/llama/recovery_manifest.json before the kernel runs
mechanism.lifecycle: token lives only in rented-host process memory; never printed, written, committed, or embedded in URLs (all logged URLs redacted); destroyed with the pod

fail_closed_rules: package/image pin drift (torch 2.10.0+cu128, cuda 12.8, transformers 4.57.6, bitsandbytes 0.48.1)
snapshot identity mismatch on any file
any frozen kernel gate (spec, keyspace, smoke schema, call counts)
science_invariance: no model/prompt/schema/consumer/decoding/evidence/estimand change; the frozen kernel file runs verbatim; verifier accepts the already-allowed hf_token_kaggle_secret source
